scope: Read-only public vendor documentation discovery for ADP, The Work Number/Equifax, Certiphi and Nursys e-Notify.
method: Official websites, developer documentation, linked PDFs and previously verified public Amergis relationship evidence. No login, account creation, credential request, form submission, personal record query or operational API request.
critical_boundary: A vendor API product does not show that Amergis enables or uses it, and does not grant access to any Amergis tenant or records. This is an independent functional-reconstruction integration map.

amergis_relationship.evidence: Help Center routes paystubs, W-2s and address changes to ADP. ADP payroll edition, tenant configuration and API subscriptions are not disclosed.

verified_documentation.claim: ADP offers HR, time/labor, payroll and other APIs. Client access requires API Central; marketplace partners require program acceptance. Available APIs vary by ADP product.
Public Workforce Now examples expose worker retrieval and worker-change interfaces. Workforce Now is an example integration target, not a verified Amergis product edition.
Subscribed change notifications can use a queue or webhooks. Changes should trigger retrieval of current record data; delivery may lag. Event support varies by API and product.

Payroll Data Input can transmit approved earnings, deductions, reimbursements and allocations into a pay-data batch; older published guide notes missing event notifications for added pay batches. Current entitlement and behavior need confirmation.

published_interface_examples.purpose: Product-specific payroll batch input; older documentation
Acknowledge processed queue notification; listed only, not executed

published_schema_examples.meaning: Total worker count in documented response

authentication_and_enrollment.summary: API Central purchase for own client data, or accepted Marketplace partnership with required agreements. Provision project credentials and mutual SSL certificate; OAuth 2.0. Product scopes and client consent/permissions are required.

sandbox_or_demo.detail: Partner self-service can request a test client instance after enrollment. API Central offers a contact-form-gated walkthrough. Neither was activated. Do not assume a public anonymous sandbox or that client subscriptions include the partner sandbox.

platforms.reconstruction_value: High for designing an independently owned payroll adapter, worker master synchronization and reconciled payroll preparation; no access to Amergis payroll records.
missing_access: API Central entitlement or partner agreement
Current product-specific limits and write approvals

platforms.platform: The Work Number / Equifax Talent Report

amergis_relationship.evidence: Amergis directs employment/income verification to The Work Number. This confirms a verification-service relationship; it does not show that Amergis uses Equifax Talent Report to screen applicants or has developer API access.

verified_documentation.claim: Talent Report Employment Staffing is a staffing-specific API product describing employment verification for the two most recent employers, including employer, title and available start/end dates.

Developer onboarding offers account creation, application/product selection, sandbox credentials, then reviewed promotion to Test and Live. OAuth 2.0 client credentials use client_id, client_secret and scope. Production API access requires approved credentials and IP whitelisting.
Sandbox uses mocked responses; Test uses realistic test data. Production access and prices are product-specific and subject to approval.

The Work Number publishes direct API, partner integration, web and batch access options. Verifiers must be contracted, credentialed and have a permissible purpose. This overview is lending-focused and is not itself a staffing API schema.

platforms.schema_status: Staffing product page explicitly gates API Reference and Additional API Docs behind sign-in. No staffing endpoint path, payload or field mapping recovered.

authentication_and_enrollment.summary: Developer account and app are needed for sandbox. Test/live require per-product review; contracting, verifier credentialing and permitted use apply. Amergis employee self-service or an employer verification code is not an API credential.

sandbox_or_demo.detail: Mock sandbox exists; no account created or calls made. Staffing product eligibility must be confirmed in an authorized developer account.

platforms.reconstruction_value: Medium for replacing manual employment-reference checks in a future staffing business after product enrollment. Employer outbound verification and applicant screening are different integrations and must remain separate.
missing_access: Developer login for schema and mock data
Employer data-contribution specification if outbound payroll reporting is required

amergis_relationship.evidence: June 13, 2024 supplier proposal names Certiphi for background, exclusions and occupational health checks; current deployment and exact integration are unverified.

marketed_integration.claim: ATS Toolbox documents front-end screening-report ordering from candidate data and back-end report delivery into client systems. It explicitly lists erecruit among supported ATS/HRMS integrations and references HR Open Standards.

The integration page lists FTP/HTTPS, username/password, client certificates, TLS and PGP among supported security mechanisms; it does not identify a particular Amergis transport or authentication configuration.

Public product catalog describes applicant-data capture, screening status/results, notifications, licensing and health-document tracking. These are product capabilities, not proof all are available through an API.

authentication_and_enrollment.summary: Client/vendor integration arrangement required. Exact protocol, endpoint, credentials, schemas and services need vendor confirmation. Public marketing is insufficient to implement a connector.

sandbox_or_demo.detail: Bounded official-site search found no self-service developer portal, sandbox or published API specification. Absence of discovery is not proof no private API or test environment exists.

platforms.reconstruction_value: Medium: define screening-order and result-ingestion workflow boundaries. Historical Amergis use plus published erecruit compatibility suggests a plausible integration path, not proof of actual Amergis connectivity.
missing_access: Screening package catalog and status codes
Documented result delivery, retries and audit requirements

amergis_relationship.evidence: June 13, 2024 supplier proposal names Nursys eNotify for licensure expiry alerts. It does not disclose use of the API.

verified_documentation.claim: Current NCSBN documentation identifies a JSON API for institution Nurse List maintenance, enrolled-nurse report retrieval, license-change notifications and API-password changes every 90 days.
The API only covers e-Notify institution functions and enrolled licenses. There is no QuickConfirm API and no SFTP option.
A free Institution Account is prerequisite. An account administrator requests credentials; the API URL is supplied with credentials and the detailed PDF is available after login under Quick Links.
Location administration cannot be done through the API; an institution administrator uses account settings.

platforms.schema_status: Current official public pages publish capabilities, not paths or JSON field names. No current schema obtained. Older third-party mirrors describing SOAP were excluded in favor of current official JSON documentation.

authentication_and_enrollment.summary: Institution account plus administrator-requested API credentials; API-password rotation every 90 days is documented. Detailed auth syntax and API URL remain gated.

sandbox_or_demo.detail: NCSBN says there is no testing environment or sample nurses/licenses. It suggests a separately created institution account designated for testing; no such account was created.

platforms.reconstruction_value: High for an independently enrolled credential-monitoring adapter. Agents can reconcile enrolled licenses and flag changes; license-readiness policy and authorized clearance remain distinct from receiving a vendor response.
missing_access: Operational testing plan with authorized data
